title: Navy Blue Embroidered Cotton Tunic Top for Women with Pink & Gold Floral Yoke – Short Kurti
color_custom: Navy blue with pink, gold & mint floral embroidery
description:
Neelambari means "dressed in blue" – deep navy with a garden of soft embroidered flowers.

A rich navy cotton tunic with a full yoke of floral thread embroidery in pink, golden mustard and mint – blooms, leaves and little birds framing the notched neckline. Embroidered borders run along the 3/4 sleeves and the side slits for a finished look.

✦ The Details
• Notched round neckline
• Multicolour floral thread embroidery on the yoke – pink, golden mustard and mint
• Embroidered borders on the 3/4 sleeves and side slits
• Straight cut, hip length
• Easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft and breathable. The pastel embroidery glows against deep navy, so it looks dressy enough for evenings too.

✦ Fit & Size
Regular, easy fit that skims the body. Choose your usual top size – size up for a relaxed look.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue flared jeans, nude heels and long silver earrings, as in our photos; white trousers for office; a cream palazzo for a festive day; a camel coat over it in winter.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
